rules.statement: The claim to the servitude of Usus is the right of using the property of others for daily needs without detriment to the substance of the property.
rules.supporting_quote: "The claim to the servitude of Usus is the right of using the property of others for daily needs without detriment to the substance of the property. (Voet Book VII, Tit. 8, Sec. 1.)"
